symptom: `textbox tb (…, AutoFocus: true)` was refused by check (MDL-WIDGET52, 'not a property mxcli writes'), and every text box mxcli wrote stored AutoFocus false, so describe -> exec cleared a Studio Pro text box's Auto focus (on native, the setting that opens the keyboard with the page).
cause: widget_write.go hard-coded g.SetAutoFocus(false) for Forms$TextBox; pages.TextBox had no field, the builder and describer never read it, and the native-props read list did not name it.
fix: pages.TextBox.AutoFocus carried end to end, mirroring Password: parsed with propBool, written as given, described only when true.
insight: Same shape as KeyboardType (#1209) and Password (#550): a hard-coded literal in the writer is a describe -> exec reset waiting for someone to set the property in Studio Pro. grep the writer for SetX(false)/SetX("Default") literals on a widget before assuming a property round-trips. Live on 11.16.1: exec, describe prints AutoFocus only on the box that has it, second exec unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
